description: Source code for map calculation and prefix matching in IPv6 network configuration, including functions for memory comparison, copying, and prefix matching, as well as a main function that processes command-line arguments to generate network rules.

methods.name: bmemcmp
methods.description: Memory comparison for bits, handling partial byte comparison.

methods.name: bmemcpy
methods.description: Memory copy for bits, handling partial byte copy.

methods.name: bmemcpys64
methods.description: Copy bits from one memory area to another, handling bit offsets.

methods.name: handle_dump
methods.description: Handles dump request, parsing blob attributes and duplicating interface data.

methods.name: match_prefix
methods.description: Matches IPv6 prefix against a list of prefixes, updating prefix length and address accordingly.
